function stopOpening(){
 openingRun++;clearTimeout(closingTimer);openingAnimation?.cancel();
 if(openingSource){try{openingSource.stop()}catch{}openingSource=null;}
}
async function playOpening(){
 stopOpening();const run=openingRun;
 const panel=document.querySelector('#anticipation');panel.hidden=false;
 const frame=document.querySelector('#anticipation-clover');
 // Wait until the revealed clover has a painted starting position.
 await new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve)));
 if(run!==openingRun)return;
 const wheel=frame.contentDocument?.querySelector('#wheel');
 if(!wheel){status('CLOVER is loading. Replay the welcome to try again.');return;}
 const duration=Math.max(1900,(openingBuffer?.duration||0)*1000);
 openingAnimation=wheel.animate([{transform:'rotate(0deg)'},{transform:'rotate(720deg)'}],{duration:duration-200,easing:'cubic-bezier(.18,.7,.25,1)',fill:'forwards'});
 if(openingAudio?.state==='running'&&openingBuffer){
  openingSource=openingAudio.createBufferSource();openingSource.buffer=openingBuffer;
  openingSource.connect(openingAudio.destination);openingSource.start();
 }
 try{await openingAnimation.finished}catch{return;}
 if(run!==openingRun)return;
 closingTimer=setTimeout(()=>{if(run===openingRun)change(sections.indexOf('research'),autoplay)},200);
}
